meta.title: Multi2API Accounts
meta.description: Turn several WorkBuddy accounts into separate, isolated models in DSH — one account per model, no cross-talk.

en.accountEnableHint: Turn an account off and it stops showing up in the model list. New accounts are on by default.
en.autoCheckinOnHint: On: every DSH start signs in all accounts once.
en.catalogHint: Read straight from the upstream account, so this is the live list. The credit rate is how many credits one call costs.
en.confirmDelete: Delete this account? The service will restart.
en.confirmHint: Finish signing in in the browser, then come back here and click the button below.
en.empty: No accounts yet. Use “Add account” to sign in.
en.enableHint: Tick a model to add it to DSH’s model list. Unticked models stay hidden, so the chat model picker stays short.
en.importHint: Pick one or several credential JSON files exported from another machine, or paste the JSON below. Each file adds one account.
en.intro: Each account becomes its own model in DSH, so sessions never cross accounts. Add an account, or switch a session to a different account model.
en.loginHint: Open the link below in a browser to sign in. If the browser did not open, copy the link below and open it yourself.
en.loginNotYet: Not confirmed yet. Make sure you finished signing in, wait a few seconds and click again.
en.noCatalog: No upstream model list yet. Try “Re-read upstream models”.
en.openFailed: Browser did not open? Copy the link below and open it yourself.
en.pickHint: You can select several JSON files at once.
